name: Kirishima
source:
A Curse Bearer who was one of the infamous "Thirteen Devil Children."

Sent by the Benio Family to assassinate Shiki, he ended up living with her at Maison sans Nom.

[From the [url=https://hanakimi.frontwing.co.jp/en/character12/]official website[/url]]

[spoiler]The grandfather of [url=/c146477]Kirishima Tsuyu[/url].[/spoiler]
